name: expr
doc:
expr: expression trees (DESIGN.md "Деревья выражений"). A lambda passed
where an `expr<F>` is expected (an argument, a typed variable, a field, a
return) becomes an `Expr<F>` value instead of a closure: the compiler
checks it as a lambda of type `F`, stores the node structure of the lambda
site as a constant (`Site`), and evaluates the captured values once, when
the tree is built, into one small block shared with the compiled closure.
`Root()` decodes the structure into `Node` values, so a library (an ORM,
a filter engine) translates the tree without any compiler hook.

items.name: And
items.signature: func And<T>(a Expr<func(T) bool>, b Expr<func(T) bool>) Expr<func(T) bool>
items.doc:
`a && b` over predicates of the same parameter type; its Compile()
evaluates `a`, then `b` only when needed. (Generic functions cannot be
variadic: AndAll takes any number of trees as a slice.)
items.summary: `a && b` over predicates of the same parameter type; its Compile() evaluates `a`, then `b` only when needed.

items.name: Children
items.doc: The children of `n` in evaluation order.
items.summary: The children of `n` in evaluation order.

items.name: FieldOf
items.doc:
The descriptor of the field a Field node reads (its attributes map it to
a column, a JSON name, ...); nil for other nodes.
items.summary: The descriptor of the field a Field node reads (its attributes map it to a column, a JSON name, ...); nil for other nodes.

items.name: Format
items.doc: Node `n` in source form; `names` are the parameter names.
items.summary: Node `n` in source form; `names` are the parameter names.

items.name: Not
items.signature: func Not<T>(p Expr<func(T) bool>) Expr<func(T) bool>

items.name: Or
items.signature: func Or<T>(a Expr<func(T) bool>, b Expr<func(T) bool>) Expr<func(T) bool>

items.name: TypeOf
items.doc: The static type of the value of node `n`.
items.summary: The static type of the value of node `n`.

items.name: Values
items.doc:
The captured and constant values of the tree in evaluation order (the
parameter list of a translation that emits one placeholder per value).
items.summary: The captured and constant values of the tree in evaluation order (the parameter list of a translation that emits one placeholder per value).

items.name: Walk
items.doc:
Calls `f` for `n` and every node below it, parents first; when `f`
returns false the children of that node are skipped.
items.summary: Calls `f` for `n` and every node below it, parents first; when `f` returns false the children of that node are skipped.

items.name: Expr
items.doc: `expr<F>`: an expression tree whose lambda has type `F`.
items.summary: `expr<F>`: an expression tree whose lambda has type `F`.

members.name: Compile
members.doc: The lambda as an ordinary function (in-memory evaluation, tests).
members.summary: The lambda as an ordinary function (in-memory evaluation, tests).

members.name: Site
members.doc:
The constant node structure of the lambda site: the same for every
evaluation of one lambda, so a translator can cache its result by
it (nil for a tree built by a combinator).
members.summary: The constant node structure of the lambda site: the same for every evaluation of one lambda, so a translator can cache its result by it (nil for a tree built by a combinator).

members.name: SiteId
members.doc:
A number identifying the lambda site in the program (-1 for a tree
built by a combinator): the key of a translation cache.
members.summary: A number identifying the lambda site in the program (-1 for a tree built by a combinator): the key of a translation cache.

members.name: Value
members.doc:
Value of slot `k` in this evaluation (`Captured.index`; Slots maps
the value nodes to their slots).
members.summary: Value of slot `k` in this evaluation (`Captured.index`; Slots maps the value nodes to their slots).

members.name: Slots
members.doc:
The slot of every Const and Captured node, in Walk order (empty for
a tree built by a combinator).
members.summary: The slot of every Const and Captured node, in Walk order (empty for a tree built by a combinator).

members.name: Root
members.doc: The root node (decoded from the site; a new tree on every call).
members.summary: The root node (decoded from the site; a new tree on every call).

members.name: Params
members.doc: Static types of the lambda's parameters.
members.summary: Static types of the lambda's parameters.

members.name: ParamNames
members.doc: Names of the lambda's parameters.
members.summary: Names of the lambda's parameters.

members.name: String
members.doc:
The tree in source form: `u => u.Age > 18 && strings.HasPrefix(u.Name, prefix)`
(captured values by their names).
members.summary: The tree in source form: `u => u.Age > 18 && strings.HasPrefix(u.Name, prefix)` (captured values by their names).

items.name: FieldInit
items.doc: A field of a Struct node (a struct literal in the lambda body).
items.summary: A field of a Struct node (a struct literal in the lambda body).

items.name: Node
items.doc:
One node of a tree. `t` is the static type of the node's value; `owner`
of a Field node is the struct the field belongs to (FieldOf reads its
descriptor). Const and Captured carry values, never source text: a
translator passes them on as parameters.

members.name: Param
members.doc: Parameter `index` of the lambda.
members.summary: Parameter `index` of the lambda.

members.name: Field
members.signature: Field(base *Node, name string, index int, t *reflect.TypeInfo, owner *reflect.TypeInfo)
members.doc: `base.name`: field `index` of struct `owner` (through a pointer too).
members.summary: `base.name`: field `index` of struct `owner` (through a pointer too).

members.name: Const
members.doc: A literal or named constant.
members.summary: A literal or named constant.

members.name: Captured
members.signature: Captured(index int, name string, value any, t *reflect.TypeInfo)
members.doc:
A captured value: a variable of the enclosing code (or a field path
of one, `req.MinAge`), evaluated when the tree was built. `index` is
its slot in the lambda site, `name` its source text.
members.summary: A captured value: a variable of the enclosing code (or a field path of one, `req.MinAge`), evaluated when the tree was built.

members.name: Call
members.doc: A call of a whitelisted function (`strings.HasPrefix`, `len`, ...).
members.summary: A call of a whitelisted function (`strings.HasPrefix`, `len`, ...).

members.name: IsNil
members.doc: `operand == nil` (`!= nil` when negated).
members.summary: `operand == nil` (`!= nil` when negated).

members.name: Tuple
members.doc: `(a, b)`: a tuple result (projections).
members.summary: `(a, b)`: a tuple result (projections).

members.name: Struct
members.doc: `T{A: x, B: y}`: a struct literal result (projections).
members.summary: `T{A: x, B: y}`: a struct literal result (projections).

members.name: Convert
members.doc:
A conversion `T(x)`; also the implicit one to an interface (a
lambda returning `any`).
members.summary: A conversion `T(x)`; also the implicit one to an interface (a lambda returning `any`).

members.name: Index
members.doc: `base[index]`.
members.summary: `base[index]`.

members.name: Lambda
members.doc:
A lambda passed to a call in the tree (`data.Any(u.Orders, o => ...)`):
its parameters are Param(first), Param(first + 1), ... in `body`.
members.summary: A lambda passed to a call in the tree (`data.Any(u.Orders, o => ...)`): its parameters are Param(first), Param(first + 1), ...

items.name: Op
items.doc: Operators of Binary and Unary nodes.
items.summary: Operators of Binary and Unary nodes.

items.name: Site
items.doc:
The constant structure of one lambda site (immortal, in read-only data):
the nodes in prefix order, their strings, and the parameter count.
Every node starts with [tag, type index]; type indices 0..params-1 are
the parameter types.
items.summary: The constant structure of one lambda site (immortal, in read-only data): the nodes in prefix order, their strings, and the parameter count.
